description: This file defines the PersistableOrder class, which represents an order entity with associated customer and product items, designed for persistence and serializability within the application.

classes.name: PersistableOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing an order with customer details and associated order products, including shipping preferences.

methods.name: setOrderProductItems
methods.description: Sets the list of products included in the order.

methods.name: getOrderProductItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a customer to the order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with the order.

methods.name: isShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Checks whether the shipping address is the same as the billing address.

methods.name: setShipToBillingAdress
methods.description: Sets the flag for shipping to billing address.
